entries.human_semantics: Flushes a wide stream's pending bytes, conditionally seeks for append, and writes the current U16 code unit or sends it through the accepted locked stream writer. Preserves the selected live PPC frame and stream error state.
entries.boundary: Accepted stream operations and their native I/O/lock contracts; generic lower ABI, faults, MMIO, concurrency, and runtime behavior remain outside this oracle.

entries.human_semantics: Outputs one code unit through the stream's U16, two-byte, converted single-byte, or reserved Unicode error-output path. Uses the recovered wide flush and accepted conversion/stream/formatting models at the original callsites.
entries.boundary: Accepted code-unit conversion, stream operations, and Unicode error-output selected ABI; native internals, faults, MMIO, concurrency, and runtime behavior remain outside this oracle.

entries.human_semantics: Calls code-unit output when the stream is writable or buffered, counts a skipped or successful unit, and writes minus one to the counter for a 0xFFFF result.
entries.boundary: The direct code-unit callee is recovered in this family; accepted lower selected ABI and native internals, faults, MMIO, concurrency, and runtime behavior remain outside this oracle.

validation.library: Windows-native C++20 /W4 /WX shared MT library; accepted lower models reused

implementation.scope: Wide buffer flush/direct write, U16/two-byte/converted output, reserved Unicode output and live counter updates; selected state/RAM and accepted lower ABI. Native internals/faults/MMIO/concurrency/runtime remain unverified.
